purpose: literal visual-transcription recreation of a GPT Image 2 character pose; original mascot identity reference only
prompt_verbatim:
Create one original premium 4:5 character-marketing image. Use the attached approved Hi-Tide Harry illustration only to preserve the proprietary character's identity: a friendly compact red-skinned mascot with a swept flame-red forelock, pointed ears, large warm eyes, a plain white tee, red trousers, black-and-red sneakers, and a silver cape. Do not repeat the reference's salute pose and do not copy its illustration style.

Art-direction transcription: a vertically framed ultra-realistic cinematic 3D character portrait on a deep charcoal-to-burgundy black studio gradient. The full character stands in the right half of the frame, feet fully visible near the lower edge, body in a three-quarter stance. He turns toward the viewer with a gentle welcoming smile and extends his near hand forward, palm open, in an alumni invitation gesture. His other hand softly gathers the edge of the silver cape. Keep a large softly dark, uncluttered negative-space field over the entire left half for future website copy. Light him with a warm red-gold rim around the forelock, ears, cape, and shoes; use a soft key on the face; a few dim warm bokeh specks sit far behind him. Render tactile red skin, individual hair strands, a fine knit white shirt with absolutely no printing, woven red trousers, convincing rubber/leather sneakers, brushed-metal cape clasps, realistic cape folds, and a soft floor shadow/reflection.

Strict exclusions: no words, letters, shirt print, logo, seal, badge, medallion, official mark, watermark, signage, extra people, duplicate limbs, malformed fingers, cropped feet, or generic stock-pose styling. This must look like a newly rendered original character image with a welcoming high-end campaign feel.
